docs/elnis.md:heading:5fb05e70fd52968347.source: 创建 Elwisp 辅助工具

docs/elnis.md:heading:bfa75fa827da60af48.source: 与 Cron、ELyph 和 Skill 的关系
docs/elnis.md:heading:bfa75fa827da60af48.translation: Relationship with Cron, ELyph, and Skill

docs/elnis.md:list:32e2bcfc7bef15132f926.source: RSS 更新时，自动总结内容并推送给目标平台。
docs/elnis.md:list:32e2bcfc7bef15132f926.translation: When an RSS feed updates, automatically summarize the content and push it to the target platform.

docs/elnis.md:list:38595f33e6cbe40f297d2.source: 服务器异常时，让 LLM 分析日志并判断是否通知。
docs/elnis.md:list:38595f33e6cbe40f297d2.translation: When a server anomaly occurs, let the LLM analyze the logs and determine whether to send a notification.

docs/elnis.md:list:560a2987aa48ec7c07051.source: 本地脚本发现状态变化时，把结果送入 ElBot，而不是直接乱发消息。
docs/elnis.md:list:560a2987aa48ec7c07051.translation: When a local script detects a state change, send the result to ElBot instead of sending messages haphazardly.

docs/elnis.md:list:6df7762b9632af6fb51e7.source: 游戏服务器产生事件时，让 ElBot 记录、通知或执行后台任务。
docs/elnis.md:list:6df7762b9632af6fb51e7.translation: When a game server generates an event, let ElBot record it, send a notification, or execute background tasks.

docs/elnis.md:list:bd9e5e4de631eeb8a5e38.source: Webhook 收到业务告警时，先交给 ElBot 判断严重程度。
docs/elnis.md:list:bd9e5e4de631eeb8a5e38.translation: When a Webhook receives a business alert, pass it to ElBot first to determine the severity.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:07529485e6fbd77e.source: 真正进入 LLM、持久化报告或 direct 平台输出的媒体由共享 Media Center 管理，使用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 标识，不重复保留 direct 的 sandbox 下载副本。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:07529485e6fbd77e.translation: Media that actually enters the LLM, persisted reports, or direct platform outputs are managed by a shared Media Center and identified using __ELBOT_CODE_0__, avoiding redundant sandbox download copies from direct platforms.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:0953f3dd4c537cea.source: 它们可以很多、很小、很分散，职责只有一个：把外部发生了什么告诉 Elnis。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:0953f3dd4c537cea.translation: They can be numerous, small, and scattered, with only one responsibility: to tell Elnis what happened externally.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:1228f80216a01bb5.source: 现成示例、协议文档和模板见 [Elwisp Showcase](https://github.com/Elfreese/elwisp-showcase)。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:1228f80216a01bb5.translation: For ready-made examples, protocol documentation, and templates, see [Elwisp Showcase](https://github.com/Elfreese/elwisp-showcase).

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:391fdb2d72d02dd0.source: 启用 Elnis、配置 Elwisp 策略、发送 Elvena 请求，以及请求字段和投递边界，见 [Elnis 配置与使用](elnis-usage.md)。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:391fdb2d72d02dd0.translation: For enabling Elnis, configuring Elwisp policies, sending Elvena requests, as well as request fields and delivery boundaries, see [Elnis Configuration and Usage](elnis-usage.md).

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:3a4e0b570c8bf351.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 读取 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，支持按 Elwisp 名称、事件来源、事件 ID、模式和时间范围过滤，例如 __ELBOT_CODE_2__、__ELBOT_CODE_3__。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:3a4e0b570c8bf351.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ reads __ELBOT_CODE_1__ and supports filtering by Elwisp name, event source, event ID, mode, and time range, for example __ELBOT_CODE_2__ and __ELBOT_CODE_3__.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:3b4147c19d3df861.source: 普通聊天机器人通常只会响应用户消息。Cron 可以响应时间，但不知道外部世界发生了什么。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:3b4147c19d3df861.translation: Ordinary chatbots usually only respond to user messages. Cron can respond to time, but it doesn't know what is happening in the outside world.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:45c5931b1d976a6f.source: Elnis 是 ElBot 的事件监听枢纽。它像一颗恒星，接住来自各处 Elwisp 群星的信号，再由 ElBot 决定是否记录、通知、分析或执行后台任务。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:45c5931b1d976a6f.translation: Elnis is the event listening hub of ElBot. Like a star, it catches signals from the constellation of Elwisps, and ElBot then decides whether to record, notify, analyze, or execute background tasks.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:4f8681313667ed9e.source: Elvena v3 的 image/file segment 在 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中填写 HTTP(S)、data URI 或完整 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，不新增独立 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 字段。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:4f8681313667ed9e.translation: In Elvena v3, the image/file segment fills HTTP(S), data URIs, or full __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__, without adding a separate __ELBOT_CODE_2__ field.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:585e0557a679941b.source: 未被接管时，__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 会按裁决后的目标发送 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:585e0557a679941b.translation: When not taken over, __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will send __ELBOT_CODE_1__ according to the adjudicated target.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:6becce583926dcb5.source: 所属用户在同平台私聊（或 CLI 管理入口）恢复后台 Session 后，该会话永久转为普通前台会话，执行变为前台逻辑，不再自动汇报或补投递。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:6becce583926dcb5.translation: After the associated user restores the background Session via a private chat on the same platform (or the CLI management entry), the Session is permanently converted to a regular foreground Session, execution switches to foreground logic, and it will no longer automatically report or re-deliver.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:714ef44c42fc0faa.source: Elnis workspace 保存临时计算和普通工作文件。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:714ef44c42fc0faa.translation: The Elnis workspace stores temporary computations and general work files.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:7322e8505d7018b1.source: Elwisp 观察的范围不限定类型：操作系统事件、文件和日志变化、服务器状态、游戏或业务服务事件、RSS / 网页 / Webhook、数据库或队列消息、设备与传感器、本地脚本输出——任何计算机能接收、读取、监听或生成的内容。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:7322e8505d7018b1.translation: The scope of Elwisp's observation is not limited by type: operating system events, file and log changes, server status, game or business service events, RSS / webpages / Webhooks, database or queue messages, devices and sensors, local script output—anything a computer can receive, read, listen to, or generate.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:7ff9d0ef9e57e4c6.source: 简单说，Elnis 把 ElBot 从“等用户说话的机器人”扩展成“能感知外部世界的 Agent 枢纽”。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:7ff9d0ef9e57e4c6.translation: Simply put, Elnis expands ElBot from a "bot that waits for users to speak" into an "Agent hub capable of perceiving the external world."

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:90590a8f66950d60.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 模式的 HTTP 请求快速返回，实际处理由后台 worker 执行，LLM 需返回结构化结果：
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:90590a8f66950d60.translation: HTTP requests in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ mode return quickly, and the actual processing is executed by a background worker; the LLM must return a structured result:

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:9c6ac13146b34d1d.source: 报告 outbox 使用稳定媒体来源，待重试引用独立于有限期的已发送缓存。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:9c6ac13146b34d1d.translation: The report outbox uses stable media sources; references for retries are independent of the time-limited sent cache.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:a410b713fb5530e3.source: 真正写文件或运行命令仍由文件工具和 shell 工具处理。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:a410b713fb5530e3.translation: Actually writing files or running commands is still handled by the file tool and shell tool.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:adef3d9013f4f87c.source: Elnis 让 ElBot 可以响应外部世界。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:adef3d9013f4f87c.translation: Elnis allows ElBot to respond to the external world.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:c74ba82a41c93659.source: 详见 [媒体使用与清理](elnis-usage.md#下载与存储)。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:c74ba82a41c93659.translation: See [Media Usage and Cleanup](elnis-usage.md#下载与存储) for details.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:d2730b2ca27306fd.source: work 模式下超级管理员可让 ElBot 用内置工具 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 辅助创建 Elwisp：它返回创建指南、Elvena 事件模板、Elnis 配置片段、监听器脚手架、curl 测试命令和安全检查清单；
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:d2730b2ca27306fd.translation: In work mode, the superadmin can have ElBot assist in creating Elwisp using the built-in tool __ELBOT_CODE_0__: it returns creation guides, Elvena event templates, Elnis configuration snippets, listener scaffolding, curl test commands, and security checklists;

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:eabfafe1627d0a1e.source: 完整选项见[日志和审计](commands.md#日志和审计)。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:eabfafe1627d0a1e.translation: For full options, see [Logs and Audit](commands.md#日志和审计).

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:edfa67e8209c68e6.source: Elwisp 不获得媒体管理 RPC，外部工具也不会收到宿主导出文件。
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:edfa67e8209c68e6.translation: Elwisp does not obtain media management RPCs, and external tools will not receive host-exported files.

docs/elnis.md:paragraph:f8aa823d9abed3a8.source: Elwisp 自己的文件由外部进程管理；
docs/elnis.md:paragraph:f8aa823d9abed3a8.translation: Elwisp's own files are managed by external processes;

docs/elnis.md:table:00fd64cc0446f65176b1.source: Elwisp 向 Elnis 投递事件的 JSON over HTTP 协议。
docs/elnis.md:table:00fd64cc0446f65176b1.translation: The JSON over HTTP protocol for Elwisp to deliver events to Elnis.

docs/elnis.md:table:0d10bce254de0e08e7f7.source: 只记录事件，不调用 LLM，不发送通知。
docs/elnis.md:table:0d10bce254de0e08e7f7.translation: Only record events, without calling the LLM or sending notifications.

docs/elnis.md:table:18dc32860842b8d3ea83.source: 把“外面发生了什么”变成统一事件：来源、事件 ID、内容、期望处理方式、期望投递目标。
docs/elnis.md:table:18dc32860842b8d3ea83.translation: Transform "what happened outside" into a unified event: source, event ID, content, expected processing method, and expected delivery target.

docs/elnis.md:table:404cb10b9e27a2147574.source: 事件归档、接入测试、低优先级信号。
docs/elnis.md:table:404cb10b9e27a2147574.translation: Event archiving, integration testing, low-priority signals.

docs/elnis.md:table:75af66cec73b2bc9120c.source: ElBot 内部事件入口 runtime，与平台 runtime、Cron runtime 同级装配。
docs/elnis.md:table:75af66cec73b2bc9120c.translation: The internal event entry runtime of ElBot, assembled at the same level as the platform runtime and Cron runtime.

docs/elnis.md:table:81a4460ccdd5cc2ca998.source: 把经验或代码沉淀成可被发现和调用的能力。
docs/elnis.md:table:81a4460ccdd5cc2ca998.translation: Condense experience or code into discoverable and callable capabilities.

docs/elnis.md:table:888118643ee068b3ed0c.source: 简单告警、外部系统已生成可读消息。
docs/elnis.md:table:888118643ee068b3ed0c.translation: Simple alerts, readable messages already generated by external systems.

docs/elnis.md:table:8a0298b8b0a2b35618de.source: 到点执行 direct 或 LLM 任务。
docs/elnis.md:table:8a0298b8b0a2b35618de.translation: Execute direct or LLM tasks when the time is reached.

docs/elnis.md:table:91b6cecc8edcbd2a2970.source: 接收 Elwisp 投递的事件并分发处理。
docs/elnis.md:table:91b6cecc8edcbd2a2970.translation: Receive events delivered by Elwisp and distribute them for processing.

docs/elnis.md:table:99eefee9100ef3a2b30a.source: 需要分析、归纳、判断或使用工具的事件。
docs/elnis.md:table:99eefee9100ef3a2b30a.translation: Events that require analysis, induction, judgment, or the use of tools.

docs/elnis.md:table:b05ff7fb0d07327ad2bf.source: 进入后台 LLM Session，由模型分析后决定是否报告。
docs/elnis.md:table:b05ff7fb0d07327ad2bf.translation: Enters a background LLM Session, where the model analyzes it to decide whether to report.

docs/elnis.md:table:cf38ca9e58477912b080.source: 校验 token 与协议字段；

docs/elnis.md:table:e1fa708a3c46e2d9bf85.source: 用结构化方式描述任务、步骤和约束。
docs/elnis.md:table:e1fa708a3c46e2d9bf85.translation: Describe tasks, steps, and constraints in a structured manner.

docs/elnis.md:table:f65dfca21fa9f0474ec6.source: 按 Elnis 裁决后的目标直接发送文本通知。
docs/elnis.md:table:f65dfca21fa9f0474ec6.translation: Directly send text notifications to the target determined by Elnis.
